'''Barracks''' is a location in the [[Crossroads]]. It is unlocked after completing the [[quest]] "[[Fighting Spirit Required]]".

Here, the [[Keeper]] can prepare the defenses.

== Swords ==
Building barricades and hiring mercenaries gives {{Icon|Barracks}}. Mercenaries needs {{Icon|Silver Coin|5}} and adds {{Icon|Barracks|8}}.

== Squads ==
An {{Item|Defender's Emblem}} can be delivered to the Battle Ram, located on the right side of the Barracks, to increase the number of squads. Each squad can contain up to 4 [[zombies]], which can be equipped with weapons and armor to increase {{Icon|Barracks}}.
